last_verified_note: last_verified is the date the corpus was last exercised by the test suite: the ledger is regenerated after a full suite run, and every registered check is run by it. A per-check date arrives with the verification-record store (REQ-PROOF-*). It is committed content, not a wall-clock read, so --check is byte-stable.

items.reason: Public storage, IAM policy, a declared read-only config snapshot and credential artifacts are covered by the existing read-only checks.
Blob exposure, managed-identity metadata and a declared read-only config snapshot are covered by the existing read-only checks.
Storage exposure, service-account key material and a declared read-only config snapshot are covered by the existing read-only checks.
A read-only posture check reads the account's droplets, managed databases, load balancers and firewalls with a vault-supplied cloud-token credential. GET only.

OCI signs every request with RSA-SHA256 over a tenancy-specific key fingerprint and an HTTP-dated canonical string. A partial signing implementation would misreport posture, so this release records the gap rather than a token check.

Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI (RPC style) requires HMAC-SHA1 over a canonicalised, sorted parameter string and per-API version metadata. A guessed scheme would produce false clean results, so this release records the gap explicitly.
